ul_mu_mimo_receive_processing_mode.description: Preserve all received antenna branches and perform interference rejection per resource element using measured channel and covariance evidence.

mu_mimo_spatial_subspace_noise_margin_db.description: Receiver-noise margin for detecting complete frequency-selective SRS spatial subspaces.

joint_pdcch_admission_policy.description: Explicit gNB DL/UL priority over installed physical PDCCH candidates; no aggregation reduction or receiver bypass.

ul_precoding.description: Explicit higher-layer one/two/four-port PUSCH codebook context for TS 38.212 DCI 0_1; validated against SRS/PUSCH before grant packing. A single port has no transmitted precoding/rank field.

constellation_capture_scope.description: Retain a bounded constellation preview or every paired TX/receiver data symbol; full_allocation forbids persistence downsampling.

planned_allocation_encoding.description: Preserve exact RE coordinates either once per slot or as exact periodic templates with explicit occurrence-slot identities.

receiver_replay_capture_max_trials.description: Maximum complete receiver replay captures per direction and run folder; zero disables capture.

pdsch_channel_estimation_averaging_windo.notes: [frequency,time] odd positive lengths, or zero for native automatic selection; validated by the receiver. Not an oracle channel.
